stem.text: The boiling points of methane, ethane, propane and butane are given.
Which statement explains the increase in boiling point from methane to butane?

A.text: Closer packing of molecules results in stronger van der Waals’ forces.

B.text: More covalent bonds are present and therefore more energy is required to break the bonds.

C.text: More electrons in the molecules results in stronger van der Waals’ forces.

D.text: More hydrogen atoms in the molecules results in stronger hydrogen bonding.
